basics.name: Abhishek Pandey
basics.label: Mechanical Design Engineer
basics.summary: I am a Mechanical Design Engineer with experience in product development across electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, and ergonomic consumer products. With a Master's in Design Science from the University of Michigan and industry experience at Godrej & Boyce and BarrelCharge Solution Inc., I specialize in CAD modeling, sheet metal design, structural analysis (FEA), and cross-functional collaboration for efficient, manufacturable solutions. My work has led to measurable improvements in cost reduction, product performance, and design optimization. I’ve also contributed to motorsport-inspired academic projects like SAE Baja and Human Powered Vehicles, reinforcing my ability to design with both precision and creativity. Motivated by a passion for innovation and sustainability, I strive to develop functional, user-centered designs that deliver real-world impact.

work.name: BarrelCharge Solutions Inc.
work.summary: In this role, I am responsible for designing and developing a 3D sheet metal enclosure for BarrelCharge products using Creo Parametric. I lead design reviews to ensure product functionality and adherence to engineering principles. My responsibilities include publishing 2D drawings, calculating Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) for prototype development, and managing the Bill of Materials (BOM) to ensure manufacturing accuracy. I collaborate closely with supplier and manufacturing teams to refine product design, identify and correct critical design flaws, which has led to an 18% increase in product space efficiency and a 22% reduction in revision time during the final production stages.

work.name: Godrej & Boyce Mfg. Co. Ltd.
work.summary: In this position, I conducted static structural analysis using ANSYS on various components of office chairs to eliminate potential failure points, significantly enhancing material selection and reducing iterations. I designed and developed the GEM Office Chair series in compliance with BIFMA and BIS test standards, leading to a 16% reduction in product failure points and a 23% decrease in production costs through rigorous testing. Additionally, I conducted comprehensive market analysis of competitor products to identify critical features, informing an innovative design strategy that resulted in a 15% increase in product quality and customer satisfaction ratings.
